sentences.en: You must be quite accustomed to using chopsticks by now.
sentences.zh: 你现在用筷子应该已经很习惯了。

sentences.en: We use chopsticks in place of knives and forks.
sentences.zh: 我们用筷子代替刀叉吃饭。

sentences.en: But there's only one pair of chopsticks. What shall we do?
sentences.zh: 但是只有一双筷子，怎么办呢？

senses.zh: 筷子,筷子( chopstick的名词复数 )
